mapper.select: select count(distinct d.id) from driver_user d join driver_user_work_status ws on ws.driver_id = d.id join driver_car_binding_relationship r on r.driver_id = d.id join car c on c.id = r.car_id where c.address = #{cityCode} and ws.work_status = 1 and r.bind_state = 1 and d.state = 1 and c.state = 0
